title: ARIA AP retrieval answer (provisional: pending decision D4)
description: The body of a 200 answer to a signed retrieval (GET <path>?operation=<id>): the operation's governing receipt and every operation receipt, oldest first. A retrieval gets no receipt of its own, and attempt refusals are never part of an operation's history. Provisional: the receipt rules are not decided, and this schema changes with them. Conforming to it says nothing about the receipts' signatures or bindings: the client verifies each receipt in retrieval mode against the attempts it kept.
$comment: Rules JSON Schema cannot express, checked by the ARIA AP SDK: current is the final receipt in history if there is one, else the latest accepted one; every receipt names the same operation.

current.description: The receipt that governs; null while the operation is claimed and has none yet.
